name: Roohaniyat
description: Prisha develops feelings for Saveer after listening to his podcast. She persistently confronts him, leaving him smitten. Despite warnings, she empathetically pursues him. Will their love blossom or will she lose herself?

videos.title: Forever Is a Lie
videos.overview: Our protagonist is Saveer Rathod who is madly in love with Ishanvi. On his birthday he asks her not to give him any kind of surprise but himself gets surprised and shocked when his fiancé gets killed just to realize that he is being blamed for the same

videos.title: Middle Finger
videos.overview: Prisha is upset about what happened with Rishi, in anger she decided to fill her bag with gifts she also tells her mother that she has decided to change her college course her mother supports her decision

videos.title: Blind Date
videos.overview: Saveer is still wondering about the footage in the pen drive. The gang of friends has returned from Mahabaleshwar, Prisha seems to be in a bad mood, and she speaks about an addition of a vamp type character in her life, Gouri & Diggy leave her to her thoughts.

videos.title: Thank You
videos.overview: Prisha wakes up in a hospital bed as she gets flashes of the previous night. She looks for her friends who are also admitted they discuss the chain of events that took place in the previous night.

videos.title: Suicide Attempt
videos.overview: Saveer is getting ready, yet again he finds his pen drive. He finds strange footage of himself; he tries to recreate it but then wonders why he would do something like that. Prisha sees her mother thinking about the previous happy moments of her marriage, but she is thinking about how things got sore between her and Ashok.

videos.title: Unconditional Love
videos.overview: Saveer is surprised to see that Prisha is his blind date. He gets upset and explains how she is behaving childish this puts a thought in Prisha’s head. Saveer gets back into his car we see someone keeping an eye on him.

videos.title: Destiny
videos.overview: Anu jokes about how a 19-year-old put Saveer in a spot. Meanwhile the rest of the office staff introduce the gang to Rooh Publications. After their work the gang decides to go for a movie Saveer in his car notices a bubbly Prisha.

videos.title: Dream
videos.overview: Saveer is discussing his grandmother health with the doctor. Anu asks Saveer to meet the interns he refuses and tells Anu to handle it. Saveer is thinking about Ishanvi in his cabin.

videos.title: Roohaniyat
videos.overview: Saveer visits his grandfather’s tomb he is worried about his life. Prisha is rushing to office she drops all her papers and Saveer reaches but he doesn’t help her this ticks off Prisha.

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: Prisha is drooling over Saveer as he enters the office, he is about to walk towards Prisha but he is interrupted by Anu.

videos.title: Girlfriend Killer
videos.overview: Prisha and Gouri are discussing about Saveer at the breakfast table, later Rishi comes to meet Prisha and they have an argument Prisha tells him to stay away Saveer sees this. At the breakfast table Prisha and Gouri see Diggy arrive with Mrinal they enquire if there is something between them and Diggy refuses.

videos.title: Who the Hell Is Prisha
videos.overview: Saveer is in his room thinking about his conversation with Prisha. Anu enters his room, mean while Prisha is looking up Saveer’s murder case. Anu makes a move on Saveer he is drunk, and he happens to see Prisha he pushes Anu away and passes out.

videos.title: Departure
videos.overview: Prisha is upset and is standing by the pool, her leg slips, and she falls into the pool. Saveer arrives at the last minute and saves her. Next morning Prisha wakes up with a hangover and Gouri and Diggy taunt her about her dinking, they revisit her story and make fun of her.

videos.title: Thank You
videos.overview: Prisha, Gouri & Diggy are discussing her attraction for Saveer, Gouri and Diggy get worried that she is falling for him. Saveer is at home he has made pasta for himself he gets a call from Anu she says that Prisha has uploaded a podcast that she has not approved, but there is no problem as the podcast is good.

videos.title: I Am in Love
videos.overview: Prisha says thank you to Saveer they have a romantic moment. Prisha has a moment with Saveer’s saxophone, and the gang has a fun moment with each other. Anu and Saveer are talking in his cabin she is telling him that Prisha is an excellent writer.

videos.title: She Has a Crush on You
videos.overview: On the club’s anniversary waiter is distributing shots to people. Prisha, Gauri and Diggi are dancing. Rehman approaches Prisha to dance with him but she refuses. Gouri hits him and everyone starts fighting.

videos.title: Laghbagh
videos.overview: Prisha dreams about Saveer who is romantically asking her to express her feelings. Prisha is kissing in the dream and all this is being watched by Gauri and Diggi who are making her video. Diggi tries to understand why Gauri and Prisha have fallen for mature guys to which Gauri says that girls get mature faster so they gel well with older men.

videos.title: Kaash Aur Laghbagh
videos.overview: The pink shoe person is on the same bus as Prisha, thinking about Saveer and filling the diary with her words. Prisha is dreaming about Saveer when she sees that Saveer is in a bathtub in the center of the garden and asks Prisha to come and sit near him by calling her Isha.

videos.title: First Kiss
videos.overview: Prisha removes the cigarette buds on her scooty through the same warning of ‘Stay away’ repeated on a poster which is on the rod of a spear. Saveer realizes that he loves Prisha while watching the footage of the photo shoot in which Prisha is there.

videos.title: He Is Chasing Me
videos.overview: Prisha has an illusion of Saveer. Saveer reaches home and wonders how Ishanvi’s photo frame is broken. He checks his house but doesn’t find anyone. He talks to Ishanvi’s photo asking if she is okay with Prisha being in his life. He receives a positive response.

videos.title: We Are a Couple
videos.overview: A parking siren breaks and Saveer wonders how come his car has come home. He doesn’t understand where he has kept the keys and so he calls Krishna who tells him that he had messaged him to repair his car and had asked him to keep the keys under the doormat.

videos.title: Happy Birthday Prisha Srivastava
videos.overview: Anu is very upset. On a video call, Gauri tells Prisha that maybe Saveer is planning a surprise for her. Someone is watching Prisha from outside her room window. When Prisha gets up the next day she sees some mud on her floor and asks Priya about the same who wishes her a very happy birthday and asks her to wear the new top.

videos.title: Adhuri Kiss
videos.overview: Prisha and Saveer are returning and we go into a flashback where Prisha remembers how the tent caught fire and Saveer got a lighter with SR encrypted on it. Saveer asks Prisha to leave from there. Priya makes Ashok taste his own medicine when he confronts Priya on meeting Madhur.

videos.title: Fur Wala Stole
videos.overview: Saveer sees the video of how his and Prisha’s photo was burnt by the lighter in his hands. He is not able to understand when he shot this from the camera. He sees Ishanvi who tells him that he should tell the truth to Prisha as his birthday is approaching.

videos.title: Self Isolation
videos.overview: Prisha wakes up at home though she remembers being at the Saveer’s place. Saveer is in a shower. His phone rings. He sees Prisha’s missed calls he feels he is doing the right thing and doesn’t call her back.

videos.title: Dil Pe Tattoo
videos.overview: Shelly asks Prisha if Saveer is her boyfriend and hands over Rishi and Prisha’s photos to her. Prisha warns Shelly that Rishi has not moved on yet a person who can ditch once can do it twice. Prisha meets Saveer at the Rooh office and forcefully sits in his car while he tries to come out.

videos.title: Forever Is a Lie
videos.overview: It's midnight when his birthday starts and the doorbell rings. Saveer opens the door and finds a bouquet with a box wrapped in a happy birthday wrapper in which he finds a knife with SR written on it. Prisha’s voice enquires from him if this gift is for her and she vanishes.

videos.title: Life and Death
videos.overview: The previous season ends when we see Saveer pushing Prisha from a cliff to find out if she will survive and if Saveer is responsible for her accident

videos.title: Back Off Prisha…Back Off…
videos.overview: While Prisha battles between life and death. Inspector Rebeiro has started investigating her case. Prisha's friends and family are worried for her health and Saveer wakes up at his old farmhouse.

videos.title: Not Again Saveer
videos.overview: We see Saveer in the hospital but to our surprise, he is here to threaten Prisha, tell her to stay away or she won't be lucky next time. Prisha's family is wondering how all of this conspires. Meanwhile, a broken Saveer visits the police station to confess.

videos.title: Saveer Gayab Hai
videos.overview: After a few days, we see Prisha walking in the hospital garden she seems to have recovered well. Prisha is back in her room the nurse tells her to rest if she wants to get better soon. She feels Saveer standing in front of her he apologizes for her condition. Anu comes to the farmhouse with cup noodles She introduces him to Brownie. We see Saveer visiting his Dadi at the rehab.

videos.title: Warning
videos.overview: Prisha tells Shelly and Priya that she is bored sitting at home and she wants to go to the office they argue about Saveer. Prisha goes to Rooh Ofiice and everybody is happy to see her. Prisha walks into Saveers cabin and she is shocked to see Anu sitting there. Saveer gets a call from Anu she tells him Prisha had come to the office and created a scene. We are introduced to a mysterious den with multiple CCTV screens.

videos.title: Rooh Se Rooh Tak
videos.overview: Prisha decided to share her message with Saveer via the Rooh podcast. Anu doesn’t like that Saveer is listening to the podcast and gets highly emotional. The next day there is an explosion in Saveers Farmhouse.

videos.title: 24 Ghante Ka Challenge
videos.overview: Saveer and Prisha have a moment in the rain (romantic). Prisha gets an idea to break into Saveer's house. She later gets arrested for this but Anu decides to not press charges against her.

videos.title: Yehi Sach Hai
videos.overview: Shelly and Prisha walk into their parent's room & see them fighting, they get to know that their father is having an affair mean while Saveer gets news that Dadi has been taken away from rehab this worries him and he also finds out that his dog Brownie has been killed. Anu pacifies Saveer.

videos.title: The Proof
videos.overview: Anu Saveer and Rebeiro are still looking for Dadi Shelly and Priya have a family discussion about love Prisha finally gets to know where Saveer is and she rushes to meet him we see someone is keeping an eye on them Rebeiro meets with a big accident and it looks like Saveer is driving the car.

videos.title: Khulasa
videos.overview: Prisha relives her night with Saveer she later gets news that Rebeiro has met with an accident in the college we see Diggy falling for one of the professors later in the episode Saveer meets Anu and things don’t go well.

videos.title: Tit for Tat
videos.overview: Saveer has been trying to get in touch with Anu he cannot get through the reach Rebeiro's house and they are shocked to see a mysterious person roaming around the house they try Anu's phone and this person picks up Saveer and Prisha rush to Anu's house.

videos.title: Gifty
videos.overview: Saveer leaves for Udaipur to look for answers here he realises that he has a twin. On the other Gouri and Prisha feel Diggy's date is Mysterious the rush to the club.

videos.title: Forever Is True
videos.overview: Prisha is kidnapped Saveer is looking for her he finally reaches the place she is held captive and Saveer is face to face with his biggest demon.
